brief:
Authorities in Hebron arrested 56 people in connection with burning cables, batteries, and vehicle waste, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation targeted individuals engaged in environmental violations linked to the illegal disposal of hazardous materials through incineration in the city.

The crackdown reflects growing concern over waste management practices in the West Bank. Burning cables and batteries releases toxic fumes and heavy metals into the air, while contaminating soil and water supplies in surrounding areas. Officials have stepped up enforcement against such practices as environmental degradation worsens across Palestinian territories.
title: Hebron authorities arrest 56 over illegal burning of cables and vehicle waste
